paragraphs: Berkeley Varitronics Systems is a privately owned family business that has delivered custom wireless RF engineering products and solutions since 1972. It sells wireless security, detection and testing equipment to law enforcement, government and critical infrastructure buyers. The instruments detect covert cell phones, BLE tags, skimmers and rogue wireless devices.

BVS has designed, manufactured and shipped its own branded products from a headquarters in Metuchen, NJ since 1990, and the catalog has grown to some 200 unique products. PocketHound, a covert phone detector, has sold in the thousands to law enforcement, universities and correctional facilities. TransitHound, a cellular detection system built for mass transit, has been deployed in over 15,000 locomotives.

BVS also worked with law enforcement to unveil card skimmer detection products such as Skim Scan, Skim Swipe and BlueSleuth-Pro. Its clients range from NASA to Fortune 500 companies and small entrepreneurs seeking rapid development and prototyping.

quote.text: BVS has deployed tens of thousands of wireless security, test, safety and cybersecurity products worldwide.
